title: IMP-0018 Phase 1: shared run-level prompt prefix, synthetic before/after
summary: Synthetic before/after comparison of shared run-level prompt prefix (IMP-0018 Phase 1) using deterministic offline harness, no network or model calls. Rendered every prompt of a synthetic orchestrator run (14 calls: 4 implementer, 2 test_author, 1 repairer, 6 reviewer, 1 planner) with the shared_prefix flag off and on, modelled provider prompt caching using longest common character prefix with earlier prompts, and measured via the context_economy harness. Before (flag=False): total 96,701 input tokens (79,064 cached, 17,637 uncached); worker input 89,617 tokens (79,064 cached, 10,553 uncached). After (flag=True): total 96,706 input tokens (82,997 cached, 13,709 uncached); worker input 89,622 tokens (83,997 cached, 6,625 uncached). Uncached reduction: 3,928 tokens (22.27% of total, 37.23% of worker input). Cache-read share increased from 0.8176 to 0.8582 overall, 0.8822 to 0.9261 for workers. Amplification pooled metrics unchanged (7.61 vs 7.61). The fixture uses synthetic diffs, fixed project state, and per-node worktree paths. Limits: Orchestrator-written text is about 1% of provider input (per EVR-0018 amplification 104.8x); most fixed overhead is the agent CLI's system prompt and tool schemas, which Phase 1 does not touch. Reduction is modelled on automatic token-granular prefix caching (OpenAI/Codex style) and is an upper bound for providers with coarser caching. Real-run re-measurement with `orchestrate context-economy` is still pending. EVR-0018's fixed overhead share (99.05% of worker input) is an upper bound that likely includes provider harness overhead (~6000 tokens/call) that Phase 1 cannot reduce. The default decision (2026-10-02) is False due to a test failure in `test_orchestrator_telemetry.EngineTelemetryTests.test_context_selection_is_recorded_for_registered_projects` when the flag is on; follow-up required to emit the prefix event under a different telemetry type or add the missing `candidate_*` fields.

metrics.method: synthetic fixtures with deterministic provider-model prefix caching
